overview: This House resolution assigns Representative Mejia to the Committee on Homeland Security, one of the permanent House panels where bills are first reviewed. It sets her seniority on the committee immediately after Representative Walkinshaw. Resolutions like this are a routine way to fill committee seats when members join the House or change assignments. The House agreed to it on April 21, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a routine step that fills a committee seat so the House can carry out its work.
against: Critics say there is little to object to, since this is an internal housekeeping measure that doesn't change any law or spending.
